name: payment-card
description: The payment card screens: the saved card and the form to add one. `PaymentCardDetails` draws the saved card (`credit-card`) beside a `description-list` (issuer, last digits, holder, expiry) from the gateway's data (`number` with hidden digits, `issuer`, `name`, `expiry`), with `actions` under it; `PaymentCardRemove` is the destructive button that asks through a `ConfirmDialog` and runs `onRemove` with the dialog pending, showing an error if it throws. `PaymentCardForm` is a react-aria `Form` that lays `PaymentCardPreview` beside `PaymentCardFields` (stacked when narrow); its fields are ready-made react-aria `TextField`s that feed the live preview with their value and focus (the code field turns the card): `PaymentCardNumberField` (masked by issuer), `PaymentCardNameField` (`part="first"`/`"last"` split it for gateways that take them apart), `PaymentCardExpiryField` (`MM/YY`) and `PaymentCardCodeField` (digits, sized by the issuer). Each takes `value`/`onChange` or `defaultValue`, `name`, `validate`, `isInvalid` and `errorMessage` (for react-hook-form's `Controller`), `label` and `description`; validate with the `credit-card-validation` lib. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `label`, `placeholder` and `i18n.labels`.
